重生不为后之嫡女无双最新章节_二十四 灌酒第1页_重生不为后之嫡女无双痞子雪_热点小说网
> 二十四 灌酒（第1页）
蓝烨磊见状忙说：“爹、娘请放心，我会把沛珊看的比自己的命还重要，”抓住沈沛珊的手，放在自己的胸口上，“这一生，我不会让她受一点点的委屈，不会让她伤心难过。对她的爱，此生不变，至死不渝！”许下了一生的承诺，蓝烨磊看向沈沛珊，低头吻住她的手，“沛珊，跟着我一生一世，我们两人永结同心，好吗？”
沈沛珊被蓝烨磊的誓言感动的热泪盈眶，不知说些什么，只是红着眼猛点头。
这边的两人情意绵绵，却是激怒了一旁观看的某人。
沈傲珊眼底满含恨意，心道：“沈沛珊，同是父亲的女儿，为什么你就可以嫁给当朝将军，过的如此幸福？而我就只能许给京城守备的中郎将，仅仅是个从四品的官员？为什么？就因为你我出身不同，嫡出与庶出就要差这么多？论相貌才色，我不比你沈沛珊差，为什么我就不能选择一个我自己喜欢的人？过我自己想要的生活？而你就可以随意散播你的幸福给我看？”沈傲珊越想越气，真恨不得直接把蓝烨磊抢过来做自己的丈夫。
沈沛珊领着蓝烨磊逐个介绍家中的人。
有一些是朝廷中的官员，大家经常接触，很是熟稔，此刻成为一家人，自是要彼此拉拢下关系，以巩固自己的官场地位。
那些官员的妻子小妾，更是拉着沈沛珊的手不放，塞下很多礼物，此时这亲戚关系就更近了一层。
介绍到沈傲珊时，她借酒醉轻轻靠在蓝烨磊身上，被蓝烨磊不露痕迹的推开了。
沈傲珊眯着一双媚眼，脉脉含情的看着蓝烨磊，一袭大红丝裙领口开的很低，露出丰满的胸部，面似芙蓉眉如柳，比桃花还要媚的眼睛十分勾人心弦，一头黑发挽成高高的美人髻，满头的珠花在阳光下耀出刺眼的光芒，鲜红的嘴唇微微上扬，似乎在告诉蓝烨磊随时可以品尝。
如果是旁人，定会被沈傲珊的妩媚迷惑，可是蓝烨磊的心中只有沈沛珊一个人，所以，他并没有理会沈傲珊，而是继续与沈沛珊敬酒。
沈傲珊心中不由得更加气恼，心想着自己的容貌姿色并不逊于沈沛珊，为什么这个男人都没正眼看自己一眼？
所有的家人介绍完毕，沈夫人推说身体不适，让沈沛珊陪同回房休息。其实，是心中不舍女儿，想多与女儿相处。
沈沛珊走后，沈傲珊就更没有顾忌了，她与其他兄弟姐妹说：“这个姐夫好大的面子，都没有陪我们喝酒。我们一起敬他酒，把他灌醉如何？”
蓝烨磊是个老实人，不会拒绝别人的邀请，谁敬酒都喝上三大杯。
虽说他的酒量很大，可是也禁不住这许多人蓄意的轮番敬酒。没多久，他就有些醉了。
很快的，蓝烨磊就晕晕的，有些分不清东南西北。

The latest chapter of The Reborn Daughter Wushuang_Twenty-Four Drinking Page 1_The Reborn Daughter Wushuang Ruffian Snow_Hot Novel Network
> Twenty-Four Drinking (Page 1)
Upon seeing this, Lan Yelei hurriedly said: "Father, please don't worry, I will value Peishan more than my own life." He grabbed Shen Peishan's hand and placed it on his chest. "In this life, I will not let her suffer any injustice. I will not let her suffer any injustice." Sad and sad. My love for her will remain unchanged until death!" After making a lifelong promise, Lan Yelei looked at Shen Peishan, lowered his head and kissed her hand, "Peishan, follow me for the rest of your life, and we will always be together, okay?"
Shen Peishan was moved to tears by Lan Yelei's vow. She didn't know what to say, but just nodded sharply with red eyes.
The two people here were very affectionate, but it angered someone watching from the sidelines.
Shen Aoshan's eyes were full of hatred, and she thought to herself: "Shen Peishan, we are both the daughters of our father, why can you marry the general of the dynasty and live so happily? And I can only marry the general of the imperial court, a general of the fourth rank, just an official of the fourth rank? Why? Just because you and I have different backgrounds. So much difference? In terms of appearance and talent, I am no worse than you, Shen Peishan, so why can't I choose someone I like and live the life I want? And you can just spread your happiness to me?" Shen Aoshan became more and more angry, and she really wanted to snatch Lan Yelei away as her husband.
Shen Peishan led Lan Yelei to introduce everyone in the family one by one.
Some of them are officials in the imperial court. They have frequent contact with each other and are very familiar with them. Now that they have become a family, they naturally need to build relationships with each other to consolidate their official status.
The wives and concubines of those officials even held Shen Peishan's hand and stuffed her with many gifts. At this time, the relationship between relatives became even closer.
When Shen Aoshan was introduced, she took advantage of her drunkenness to lean on Lan Yelei's body, but was pushed away by Lan Yelei without leaving any trace.
Shen Aoshan squinted her charming eyes and looked at Lan Yelei affectionately. She wore a bright red silk dress with a low neckline, revealing her plump breasts. Her face was like a hibiscus and her eyebrows were like willows. Her eyes that were more charming than peach blossoms were very attractive. Her black hair was pulled into a high bun, and the beads on her head shone dazzlingly in the sun. Her bright red lips were slightly raised, as if to tell Lan Yelei that he could taste it at any time.
If it were anyone else, they would definitely be confused by Shen Aoshan's charm, but Lan Yelei only had Shen Peishan in his heart, so he ignored Shen Aoshan and continued to toast with Shen Peishan.
Shen Aoshan couldn't help but feel even more angry, thinking that her appearance was not inferior to Shen Peishan's, why didn't this man look at her?
After all the family members were introduced, Mrs. Shen asked Shen Peishan to accompany her back to her room to rest because she was feeling unwell. In fact, I feel reluctant to let go of my daughter and want to spend more time with her.
After Shen Peishan left, Shen Aoshan had no scruples anymore. She said to her other brothers and sisters: "This brother-in-law is so proud that he doesn't even drink with us. How about we toast him together and get him drunk?"
Lan Yelei is an honest person and will not refuse invitations from others. He will drink three glasses of wine to anyone.
Even though he had a large capacity for drinking, he couldn't help but many people deliberately taking turns to toast. It didn't take long before he became a little drunk.
Soon, Lan Yelei became dizzy and couldn't tell the difference between east, west and north.
